parameters.label: Type
parameters.note: AE popup values are one-based; index = value - 1 selects the zero-based core enum. Reference vocabulary:  Type.

parameters.label: Particles Per Second
parameters.note: Births per second on the effect clock. Default matches the reference product's 100.

parameters.label: Origin
parameters.note: AE position control with comp-view picking; the registered 50/50/50 default means the layer centre. The delivered value is normalized by adapter/core helpers (docs/parameter-mapping.md). This hidden standalone/bootstrap control remains 3D; native Emitter layout 4 exposes separate Origin XY and Origin Z.

parameters.label: Disc Size
parameters.note: Disc diameter in layer heights. Box and Sphere use their direct Size X/Y/Z dimensions.

parameters.label: Velocity X
parameters.note: Per-axis velocity,  positive right. Deliberately not called Speed:  the reference emitter's Speed is a scalar with a Direction/Angle cone model,  and its Speed X/Y/Z are per-particle rotation speeds. docs/reference-parameter-map.md tracks the model difference.

parameters.label: Velocity Y
parameters.note: Positive up. The non-zero default keeps a fresh instance visibly alive.

parameters.label: Velocity Z
parameters.note: Positive toward the viewer. Reserved for depth; the 2D compositor ignores it.

parameters.label: Speed Random
parameters.note: Independent uniform jitter per axis. Without it every particle behaves identically and a steady emitter looks frozen; this is also what makes Random Seed visible.

parameters.label: Life (Seconds)
parameters.note: Half-open:  a particle is gone once age equals lifetime.

parameters.label: Size
parameters.note: Sprite diameter at birth,  in full-resolution layer pixels. Default 10 matches the reference's observed Size (Pixels) = 10.

parameters.label: Size Over Life
parameters.note: End ordinate of the Size Over Life curve,  expressed as a percent of the Particle Size value.

parameters.label: Opacity
parameters.note: Peak alpha at the sprite centre,  at birth.

parameters.label: Opacity Over Life
parameters.note: End ordinate of the Opacity Over Life curve,  expressed as a percent of the Particle Opacity value.

parameters.label: Color Start
parameters.note: Particle style:  birth color. 8-bit channels map to working-space 0..1 with no color-space conversion (ADR 0005); alpha comes from Opacity.

parameters.label: Color End
parameters.note: Particle style:  color approached as age reaches lifetime. Equal to Color Start by default.

parameters.label: Gravity X
parameters.note: Force stage. Zero keeps the straight-line trajectory.

parameters.label: Gravity Y
parameters.note: Force stage. Negative pulls down.

parameters.label: Gravity Z
parameters.note: Force stage. Reserved for depth; the 2D compositor ignores Z.

parameters.label: Linear Drag
parameters.note: Force stage:  dv/dt = gravity - drag*v,  integrated in closed form so frame order and subframes stay exact. Label pending confirmation of the reference product's wording.

parameters.label: Max Particles
parameters.note: Maximum simultaneously live particles; the newest slots survive when the cap is hit.

parameters.label: Random Seed
parameters.note: Seeds each particle's independent position and speed streams.

parameters.label: Control Source
parameters.note: Defaults to AE Controls (revision 6):  a fresh effect drives the visible controls. USE_VALUE_FOR_OLD_PROJECTS keeps old projects on AE Controls; switching alone never replaces the stored graph.

parameters.label: Capture Current Controls
parameters.note: Replaces the stored graph with the current control values and selects Node Graph in one undoable transaction. Does not convert animation tracks.

parameters.label: Node Graph Data
parameters.note: Canonical schema-1 graph bytes; AE owns copy,  persistence and undo (ADR 0008). Hidden renderer-owned stream; arbitrary callback disk ID 31 remains unchanged.

parameters.label: Graph Revision
parameters.note: Ordinary numeric revision of the compiled native-node graph. Never read or write expressions on this stream (ADR 0019).

parameters.label: Panel Graph Sync Guard
parameters.note: Suppresses intermediate Output callbacks during a native-node transaction. Numeric commit ID 43 compiles the full saved node set (ADR 0019).

parameters.label: Commit Graph Edit
parameters.note: Supervised transaction nonce; changes are one AE undo transaction with the request and graph update (ADR 0013).

parameters.label: Graph Edit Receipt
parameters.note: Transaction nonce on acceptance and its negative on rejection; read by the panel for acknowledgement (ADR 0013).

parameters.label: Curve Edit Commit
parameters.note: Supervised nonce that commits one complete CEP curve edit into the graph in Node Graph mode (ADR 0016).

parameters.label: Size X
parameters.note: Full-resolution layer-pixel width used by Box and Sphere. Converted through layer height and pixel aspect at render time.

parameters.label: Size Y
parameters.note: Full-resolution layer-pixel height used by Box and Sphere. Converted through layer height at render time.

parameters.label: Size Z
parameters.note: Full-resolution layer-pixel depth used by Box and Sphere. Point and Disc ignore this value.

parameters.label: Size Random
parameters.note: Stable per-particle attenuation of evaluated Size Over Life. 100% varies from nearly zero to the curve value (ADR 0018).

parameters.label: Opacity Random
parameters.note: Stable per-particle attenuation of evaluated Opacity Over Life. 100% varies from nearly zero to the curve value (ADR 0018).

parameters.label: Node Effects Ready
parameters.note: Project-owned bootstrap marker. Once set, removing every editable node keeps an Output-only graph.

parameters.label: Graph Checksum High
parameters.note: High 16 bits of the compiled graph payload CRC32. Numeric receipt only.

parameters.label: Graph Checksum Low
parameters.note: Low 16 bits of the compiled graph payload CRC32. Numeric receipt only.

compatibility.idPolicy: Released numeric IDs are permanent; never renumber or reuse. IDs are still being shaped until the first shared release.
compatibility.migrationPolicy: Manifest27 appends main indices616..625/disk1640..1649. Existing streams and IDs remain unchanged; prior main effects acquire appended defaults through AE. Native Emitter7/Particle7/Force3/Output4, Core ABI3 and sequence lifecycle are unchanged. ADR0031.
compatibility.topicGroups: Native node effects remain flat. Main has functional Time Remapping and Render Settings sections; no redundant outer Output topic.
compatibility.controlSupervision: CEP writes ordinary streams on separate node effects under per-node guards and writes Output cap/position under main guard index 40. Supervised numeric index 41 compiles these records, validates them and updates the renderer-owned arbitrary graph plus revision/checksum receipts at indices 39/88/89. Index 87 distinguishes bootstrap from an intentionally empty graph. Authored expressions stay on native effects; derived UUID bindings on main inputs are installed only on the UI commit path (ADR 0023). Hidden flat controls are bootstrap inputs only; native direct-edit callback/cache/undo behavior still needs AE qualification.
